# Ralf Brown's Interrupt List

The dictionaries cite section titles and table rows of Ralf Brown's Interrupt List, release 61
(16 July 2000), one line per entry source, and nothing else of it. The source index keeps a
SHA-256 of each cited line, and a test checks every cited line against it.

The list and its licence are on the list's own page, https://www.cs.cmu.edu/~ralf/files.html.
The licence is the file `INTERRUP.1ST` in the archive `inter61c.zip` listed there.
